annotations.title: Remove a pixel from the website

description: TAKE A PIXEL OFF THE BRAND'S WEBSITE. Tag Manager: deletes the tag Hermoso installed for that pixel (only Hermoso's own, never somebody else's), as a draft, live only with publish:true through the usual publish confirmation. Wix: removes the site's marketing tag of that type only when it IS this pixel. Other sites: says where to delete the code by hand. The site stops sending that platform data once it is gone, so WITHOUT confirm:true NOTHING CHANGES and the reply names exactly what would be removed: show the user, get a yes, then call again with confirm:true. Free.

confirm.description: true to remove; without it nothing changes

confirmPublicId.description: Tag Manager only, with publish: the container's GTM-XXXXXXX id

containerPath.description: Tag Manager only: the container, when several are shared

gtmWorkspace.description: Tag Manager only: workspace id or name

pixelId.description: the id of the pixel to remove (list_tracking_tags shows them)

publish.description: Tag Manager only: also publish so the removal goes live

site.description: which site connection; default the one the brand has

name: remove_tracking_tag
